tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page background — the deepest ground. Default surface for every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card and panel background, one step up from void.

tokens.name: surface-2

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, and icons on dark surfaces (warm ivory).

tokens.name: ink-muted
